title: Effaceable locally constant integer cochain delta-functor
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group in universe $u$, put $r=\max(u,s)$, and let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with an equivalence $E:\mathcal A\simeq\operatorname{DiscreteRep}_{\mathbf Z}(G)$ [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], with carriers in universe $r$. Write $V(M)$ for the underlying additive group of $E(M)^G$. There are a functor $C:\mathcal A\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(\mathrm{Ab}_r,\mathbf N)$, additive coordinate equivalences $e_{M,n}:C(M)^n\simeq\operatorname{LC}(G^n,E(M))$, and a cohomological delta-functor $T$ [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor] such that: coefficient maps in these coordinates are pointwise $E(f)$; the differential is $d(c)(g_0,\ldots,g_n)=g_0c(g_1,\ldots,g_n)+\sum_{k=0}^{n}(-1)^{k+1}c(\operatorname{contract}_k(g))$, where contract multiplies adjacent entries for $k<n$ and drops the last entry for $k=n$; $T^q=H^q\circ C$ for every $q$; $T^0$ is naturally isomorphic to $V$; and for every $q>0$ and $M$ there is a monomorphism $M\to N$ inducing the zero map on $T^q$. This statement involves no injective resolution and asserts no derived-functor comparison.

proof.text: Obtain the locally constant cochain functor and coordinates, coefficient and differential equations, additivity, and degreewise short exactness from Rep.exists_locallyConstantCochains_exact.

Apply Mathlib degreewise short exactness to obtain short exact complexes. Construct the delta-functor with the homology functors, additive instances and snake-lemma connecting maps. Exactness at each of the three positions is homology_exact₂, homology_exact₃ and homology_exact₁. In degree zero the first term map is monic; mono_homologyMap_of_mono_of_not_rel applies because no natural number precedes zero. Naturality is δ_naturality applied to C.mapShortComplex.map of the morphism of sequences. This is proved in the private exists_homology_deltaFunctor helper.
Rewrite T.F using its defining equality and apply the proved natural degree-zero comparison locallyConstantCochains_invariants_zero.

For n>0 obtain a monomorphism M→N from locallyConstantCochains_acyclic_embedding. ExactAt.isZero_homology makes H^n(C(N)) a zero object. Rewrite T.F and use IsZero.eq_of_tgt to show its map on the monomorphism is zero.

theorem exists_locallyConstantCochains_effaceable
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (A : Type v) [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A]
    (E : A ≌ DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, max u s} ℤ G)
    : ∃ C : A ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{max u s} ℕ,
      ∃ e : ∀ (M : A) (n : ℕ),
          (C.obj M).X n ≃+ LocallyConstant (Fin n → G) (E.functor.obj M).obj.V,
        (∀ (M N : A) (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) (x : (C.obj M).X n) (g : Fin n → G),
          e N n (((C.map f).f n) x) g =
            (E.functor.map f).hom.hom (e M n x g)) ∧
        (∀ (M : A) (n : ℕ) (x : (C.obj M).X n) (g : Fin (n + 1) → G),
          e M (n + 1) (((C.obj M).d n (n + 1)) x) g =
            (E.functor.obj M).obj.ρ (g 0) (e M n x (fun k ↦ g k.succ)) +
              ∑ k : Fin (n + 1),
                (-1 : ℤ) ^ (k.val + 1) • e M n x (Fin.contractNth k (· * ·) g)) ∧
        ∃ T : CohomologicalDeltaFunctor A AddCommGrpCat.{max u s},
          T.F = (fun q ↦ C ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor
            AddCommGrpCat.{max u s} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q) ∧
          Nonempty (T.F 0 ≅
            (E.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι _ ⋙ Rep.invariantsFunctor ℤ G ⋙
              forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u s} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat)) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (M : A),
            ∃ (N : A) (f : M ⟶ N), Mono f ∧ (T.F n).map f = 0)
